title: OFS Renewables
tagline: Powering the Global Clean Energy Transition with High-Yield Solar, Storage & EPC Infrastructure.
heroDescription: OFS Renewables delivers end-to-end solar EPC support, Tier-1 PV module supply chains, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), and digital O&M platforms designed for enterprise power producers and industrial energy independence.

Central & String Inverter Substation Skid Packages (up to 33kV/66kV)

solutions.title: Commercial & Industrial (C&I) Rooftop Solar
solutions.shortDesc: Custom engineered CAPEX and OPEX solar installations for factories, warehouses, and corporate campuses.

Integrated Rapid Shutdown Systems for Fire Safety (NEC 2020)
30-40% Reduction in Levelized Cost of Electricity (LCOE)

solutions.title: Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)

solutions.title: Floating Solar (FPV) Systems

10-15% Higher Energy Yield Due to Natural Water Evaporative Cooling
